execution: completed bounded CPU plan only; no EDA, process control, production or engineering-entry edits
verdict: concrete selection/measurement semantics; native object/API behavior and candidate physical efficacy unverified
review: internal bounded completion; no user switch decision, new approval gate or implementation success inferred

sets.matched_raw: all exact-root literal-prefix matches before REF exclusions; preserve inclusion/exclusion ledger
sets.S: selected nonconstant logical primitive objects after role exclusions, before DSP physical-parent normalization
sets.P: unique placeable logic leaves plus unique DSP48E2 physical parents; only P receives the new pblock

selection.frontend_rule: include all primitive descendants; exclude exact u_cache0/ and u_cache1/ descendant sets and relative NAME prefixes below
selection.matching: literal string prefixes only; brackets are characters, not glob syntax; resolve exact roots and actual object NAME
selection.unexpected_resource_policy: Any selected clock buffer, I/O, BRAM/URAM or unsupported REF is an unexpected-selection error, not silently discarded to force expected counts.
selection.DSP_normalization: For every selected DSP object, walk native hierarchy ancestry (or exact lookup of candidate ancestor paths, with REF verification) to exactly one DSP48E2 object within intended u_hadamard. Deduplicate by actual parent NAME. No suffix guessing, no LOC grouping before placement, no direct binding of DSP internal objects; preserve raw child -> physical parent map.
semantic_invariants: Two complete independently indexed payload sets: tensor48x256 and frontend16x768, each12288 registers; distinguish real clones from missing original bits.
Exactly four intended quantizer hierarchy roots and one Hadamard root; eight unique intended physical DSP parents.
No cache/bundle payload or bundle-local CE, tensor output/DMA, SMC/MIG/PCIe, clock buffer or unrelated root in P.
Changes from physopt selector count must be explained by actual stage graph; do not force pre-place count to match physopt.

pblock.name: m002_input_locality_slr2
pblock.meaning: P must be placed inside target region; other logic may share its sites and routes may leave the region. No site exclusivity or route containment is introduced.
pblock.geometry: Enumerate actual SLR2 device sites, select all SLICE and DSP48E2 resource sites needed by P, encode their exact set as resource ranges, and verify the expanded pblock site set/SLR membership from native objects. Do not copy historical CLOCKREGION coordinates or assume arbitrary name-coordinate conversion.
precondition_rejections: Target pblock already exists with unqualified source; no delete/reuse.
Missing/ambiguous SLR2, empty resource class or inability to verify region expansion/SLR membership.
Existing fixed LOC/BEL, hard region/SLR assignment or relative-placement macro conflicts with new region; a macro requiring excluded partners is not silently broken.
Adding P would silently remove or change existing pblock membership or any noncandidate placement policy; compatible memberships must remain demonstrably preserved.
Required pblock properties absent, command failure, readback not all false, or actual member set different from P.
pblock.repair_policy: Reject the conflicting constraint application and correct the local selector/boundary/entry in the existing authorized scope; preserve existing constraints/evidence. Do not clear LOCs, soften the pblock, disable DRC or change global timing to hide conflicts. No new per-step user approval.
pblock.post_place_acceptance: All reconciled actual placeable P descendants/clones placed in SLR2; 100% compliance with zero unexplained missing/unplaced/outside objects. Record stage correspondence and effective pblock properties, not only original NAME count. Native unavailable clone correspondence remains unresolved; do not infer solely from _rep suffix.

complete_cut.selection_scope: All pins on all P logic leaves and DSP parent external interfaces, supplemented with selected DSP internal leaf views as required by native model. Any internal DSP leaf is classified inside by normalized physical-parent membership.
complete_cut.net_scope: All connected segments from these pins; merge complete native hierarchical segment closure into unique canonical electrical nets. A cut net has endpoints on both inside(P) and outside(P), including top ports; retain internal-only nets separately for coverage.
endpoint_coverage: connected top-level ports with native directions
complete_cut.top_port_semantics: Native top-level input may be an external design driver and output an external load; never count port direction exactly like a leaf cell pin. INOUT remains explicitly bidirectional/ambiguous. Missing primitive driver does not prove an undriven net.
complete_cut.pin_semantics: Classify CE/enable, reset/set, clock, data/address and handshake/status using REF plus REF_PIN_NAME and source mapping. DSP.C is data, FD.C is clock; LUT input meaning is not inferred from I0/I1 alone. Keep unknown/coarse categories explicit.
complete_cut.pre_place_spatial_rule: Record empty LOC/SLR as UNPLACED/UNKNOWN; targetSLR2 is a separate proposed-constraint field and never a measured position. The logical cut can be complete without placed spatial metrics.
complete_cut.SLL_rule: Report canonical cut nets and leaf pins separately from actual native global SLL utilization. Neither widths nor pin/net counts are SLL consumption or throughput; no large leaf-list utilization report for P.
complete_cut.timing: Retain full-design native setup/hold/pulse-width summaries for all inherited clocks. Obtain scoped worst min/max paths through boundary pins, grouped by direction/clock pair with endpoints, slack, logic/net delay and applied exceptions. Declare max_paths/filter coverage; never compute full-cut TNS or claim complete timing-path enumeration from a capped path list.
complete_cut.comparison: Use the same semantic S/P selection on original current physopt as the baseline if existing graph exports cover it, otherwise mark baseline cut NOT_MEASURED. Re-enumerate from actual pre-place and placed/physopt graph; do not join changed stages solely by canonical strings.
complete_cut.static_payload_widths: 256 and1120 are source-interface reference budgets only; optimized constants, fanout, copies, shared mux/control and external consumers can change actual cut.

before_qualification: Ambiguous/incomplete selector, unresolved DSP parent, missing semantic payload bit, excluded resource selected, incompatible fixed/region/macro constraint, or unreliable geometry/property readback must be corrected before applying an unqualified boundary.

Native cut exposes unintended raw-input/output payload crossings or shared logic/control outside the supposed producer group: explain and amend local boundary or candidate mechanism before claiming the narrow interface benefit.
New unclocked endpoints, unintended clock/reset topology change or a new qualification/major DRC failure must be addressed through existing qualification rules.
evidence_and_result: No measured overlap/connection with target hotspot requires revising the claimed hotspot applicability or candidate priority; ten sampled windows do not cover all congestion, so absence is not universal refutation.

A legal run with increased cross-SLR control delay, worse receiving-region pressure or route failure does not validate the candidate. Finish the contracted complete route unless an existing stop/qualification condition applies, preserve results, and revise the next candidate from evidence.

A required FIFO/RTL/IP/pipeline change leaves this pure-placement variable and needs a consolidated contract/verification scope update, not a silent extension or automatic global constraint relaxation.

CPU_preparation_only: A006 may prepare an unexecuted literal selector/physical-parent normalization and exclusion-ledger builder in its owned engineering area.
Prepare actual-site -> exact resource-range compression and property/member readback/rejection code; no manufactured current geometry or object results.
Prepare complete-cut endpoint/canonical schema, REF-aware CPU classifier, phase comparison and scoped timing report entry, with explicit unknown/truncation handling.

Prepare attempt/source/freeze/parent/contract bindings, same-SSI+Default flow entry and output directories as plans only; no checkpoint opening, pblock application, EDA or process control until existing dependency/authorization conditions actually hold.
Only bounded CPU syntax/identity and directly relevant parser/selector edge-case checks; no new staged approval gates or broad regression solely for this plan.
ownership: A007 writes only this plan and append-only candidate section plus own agent records. A006 owns engineering entry; parent owns contract/index/results. Existing work preserved; no descendants.
